title: “They are uncultured”: Unveiling Covert Harms and Social Threats in LLM Generated Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Generating conversational scenarios in a mock hiring context where colleagues discuss a job applicant, using counterfactual names indicative of specific caste groups (Brahmin vs. Dalit). The LLM-generated dialogues are then evaluated for Covert Harms and Social Threats (CHAST) using a human-aligned evaluator LLM.

Generating conversational scenarios in a mock hiring context where colleagues discuss a job applicant, using counterfactual names indicative of specific racial groups (White vs. Black). The LLM-generated dialogues are then evaluated for Covert Harms and Social Threats (CHAST) using a human-aligned evaluator LLM.
